title: Compatibility of ordinary finite coefficient pullback with derived units
statement: Let A be any finite commutative ring and let v:T->S be any morphism of schemes. Use the recorded ordinary finite constant coefficient and inverse image of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] in the unbounded derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write u_S and u_T for singleFunctorObjUnitIso and write r for leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso at v. Then ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback(A,v).hom followed by u_T.hom equals ordinaryFinitePullback(A,v).map(u_S.hom) followed by r.hom. No Noetherian, flatness, nonempty, or invertibility hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-coordinate-single-constant-pullback-comparison] to identify ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback with the actual canonical derived single-constant comparison. The published leftDerivedUpperStar_map_singleFunctorObjUnitIso_inv_comp says P.map(u_S.inv) followed by this comparison equals the derived-unit pullback followed by u_T.inv. The generic private unit_cancel lemma precomposes the desired identity by P.map(u_S.inv), applies that equation, and cancels the unit isomorphisms using functoriality. This proves the equality for every v, including empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring.
